# UKGigTax — Full Tax Reference 2026
> Complete UK self-employment tax data for gig workers. All figures verified against GOV.UK for the 2026/27 tax year.

## Key Tax Figures 2026

| Parameter | Value |
|---|---|
| Personal Allowance | £12,570 |
| Trading Allowance | £1,000 |
| Basic rate income tax | 20% (£12,571–£50,270) |
| Higher rate income tax | 40% (£50,271–£125,140) |
| Class 4 NI main rate | 6% (£12,570–£50,270) |
| Class 4 NI upper rate | 2% above £50,270 |
| Class 2 NI | Treated as paid at £7,105+ profit; voluntary £3.65/week below |
| VAT registration threshold | £90,000 |
| Car mileage first 10,000 miles | 55p/mile |
| Car mileage above 10,000 miles | 25p/mile |
| Bicycle mileage | 20p/mile |
| Self Assessment deadline | 31 January |
| Payment on account deadlines | 31 January + 31 July |

## Platform Tax Estimates (2026/27 tax year)

| Platform | Annual Income | Income Tax | Class 4 NI | Total Tax | Monthly Set-Aside |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Uber / Bolt | £20,000 | £1,486 | £446 | £1,932 | £161 |
| Deliveroo / Just Eat | £18,000 | £1,086 | £326 | £1,412 | £118 |
| Amazon Flex | £22,000 | £1,886 | £566 | £2,452 | £204 |
| Uber Eats | £16,000 | £686 | £206 | £892 | £74 |
| TaskRabbit / Fiverr | £25,000 | £2,486 | £746 | £3,232 | £269 |
| Airbnb hosting | £15,000 | £486 | £146 | £632 | £53 |

## Mileage Deduction Examples

| Miles/year | Rate | Deduction |
|---|---|---|
| 5,000 miles | 55p | £2,750 |
| 10,000 miles | 55p | £5,500 |
| 12,000 miles | 10k×55p + 2k×25p | £6,000 |
| 15,000 miles | 10k×55p + 5k×25p | £6,750 |

## Top Deductions for UK Gig Workers

| Deduction | Amount |
|---|---|
| Mileage (55p/mile, 10k miles) | £5,500 |
| Mobile phone (business %) | £120–£240 |
| Thermal bags / equipment | £50–£200 |
| Accountant fees | £200–£500 |
| Training / courses | actual cost |
| Home office (simplified flat rate) | £10–£26/month |

## Self Assessment Key Dates
- 5 April — end of tax year
- 31 July — payment on account (second)
- 5 October — register for Self Assessment
- 31 October — paper return deadline
- 31 January — online return + payment deadline

## HMRC Penalties
- Missing 31 January deadline: £100 automatic penalty
- 3 months late: £10/day (up to £900)
- 6 months late: 5% of tax due or £300
- 12 months late: further 5% or £300

Source: GOV.UK Self Assessment and HMRC NI guidance, checked 27 October 2026.
